title: Explosion and collapse at Aeon shopping center in Kumamoto after magnitude 7.1 earthquake
summary: The earthquake caused an explosion on the second floor of the shopping center, leaving dozens of people trapped and at least 20-30 missing.

title: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake shakes Kumamoto prefecture with aftershocks and widespread damage
summary: The quake, similar to the 2016 one, caused power outages, building damage, and a tsunami warning that was later canceled.

title: Collapse of chimneys and evacuations at factories in Kumamoto after the earthquake
summary: Several factories, including Nippon Seishi and automotive plants, suffered structural damage and stopped operations; workers are trapped.

title: Experts warn that Kumamoto earthquake could be an aftershock of the 2016 quake and recommend caution for possible aftershocks
summary: Scientists indicate that the Hinagu fault could have been the main one and that the accumulated energy in the area could still generate more quakes of similar magnitude.

title: Road closures and suspension of Shinkansen in Kyushu after Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The bullet train service was interrupted all day, and several highways recorded cracks and closures, leaving some areas isolated.

title: Japan raises national minimum wage to 1,176 yen per hour, the largest increase in six years
summary: The government commission recommended an increase of 55 yen from the previous year, although the rate of increase was lower than last year.

title: Japanese government promotes reduction of consumption tax to 1% for food from 2027
summary: The proposal seeks to ease the tax burden on households by reducing VAT on basic food products.

title: Nikkei index plunges more than 2,700 points due to massive sell-off of semiconductor stocks
summary: The drop was due to a wave of selling in the technology sector, dragging down Japan's main stock index.

title: Japan proposes forcing stalkers to use GPS devices to prevent crimes
summary: The measure aims to strengthen the protection of victims through electronic monitoring of aggressors.

title: Trump threatens to attack Iran if diplomatic talks fail
summary: The former US president warned that he will resort to military force if a negotiated agreement is not reached.

title: Kumamoto hospitals overwhelmed with more than 50 injured and multiple rescues after earthquake
summary: Several people were trapped in the rubble and medical centers reported an overflow of patients with serious injuries.

title: Japanese government deploys 3,600 Self-Defense Force personnel and establishes emergency headquarters in Kumamoto
summary: Prime Minister Takaichi ordered prioritizing the rescue of lives and mobilizing all available resources after the magnitude 7.1 earthquake.

title: Kyushu nuclear power plants show no anomalies after Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The Nuclear Regulation Authority confirmed that the Sendai, Genkai, and Ikata plants are operating normally after the quake.

title: Authorities cancel tsunami warning in the Ariake and Yatsushiro seas after the earthquake
summary: The warning for possible waves of up to one meter was lifted after the sea level remained stable.

title: International media cover Kumamoto earthquake and Taiwan offers aid
summary: The news of the magnitude 7.1 earthquake dominated global headlines, while the Taiwanese president expressed willingness to collaborate in the emergency.

title: China's BYD launches the 'Raccoon' electric vehicle in the Japanese kei-car market
summary: It is the first time a foreign manufacturer enters Japan's light car segment, with a price starting at 1.99 million yen.

title: Japanese farmers ask government to buy back reserve rice due to excess inventory
summary: The drop in rice prices leads producers to request urgent state intervention, but the ministry prefers to wait until August.

title: Legendary pitcher and presenter Eiji Bando dies at 86
summary: The figure of Japanese baseball and television was remembered for his charisma in both sports and entertainment.
